from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FacultyReport(BaseModel):
    """One university's reported full-time instructional faculty count for a specific period."""
    institution_name: str = Field(description="Name of the university or college")
    full_time_instructional_faculty: int = Field(description="Total count of full-time instructional faculty members")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="Academic year/term the data covers, e.g. 'Fall 2021'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    faculty_reports: list[FacultyReport]
